countedBy: lane landmarks-oosterdok-20261101 (opus) from the brief's Gemeente Amsterdam panorama crops w03-152.jpg (Kattenburgerstraat long front, SW end to the gate) and w01-134.jpg (the corner front to the NE block); not a blind count, 2026-11-02

facades.name: long front, SW end to the gate
facades.rowsNote: glazed openings bottom up: nine tall cream-framed ground windows (blind niches at the SW end and between the right-hand ones), seven small upper windows alternating with blind niches, nine dormers; the three arched niches before the gate are blind; the dormers stand off the window axes, so no axis count is given

facades.name: corner front
facades.rowsNote: bottom up from the left pavilion up to the NE block, whose two large dark windows are left out of the count ( the elevation starts at the B corner, so alongM begins at about 9.5 m): eight small ground windows, the two tall windows (left pavilion and under the third dormer), eight small upper windows, five dormers; the two blind oculi and the blind niches are not glazed. Photo x mapped to the front at 45 px/m from the five dormers
